Tuning check — boss reachability

2026-08-03 04:53
Dogfooding finding: the Finale is reachable (sim probe: Finale at exactly 150s, caught 171s) but only by a skilled kiter. My automation (crude swipe kiting) dies at ~60-130s; best pure-kite run hit 1004 fathoms ~2:09, within ~15% of the finale. Card-commit swipes conflict with kiting and drive the hero into the fog. Conclusion: the 2:30 arc is tuned right at the edge of a moderate player — reachable, but knife's-edge. Verifying the boss end-to-end with a temporary shortened finale.
